resolution: All 11 added claims retain appropriate population, trigger and action scope in both languages. Added text does not change existing numeric rescue/observation/product thresholds. Shared upstream guidance is disclosed; independent editorial corroboration is not independent trial replication. Cold local hives are not anaphylaxis; anaphylaxis in an established mast-cell disorder is not all MCAS or all symptoms. No unsupported home testing, dosing or perioperative premedication added.

category_decisions.rationale: Cold-triggered anaphylaxis is explicitly distinguished from local cold urticaria. Trigger/history/testing limits, urgent response, exposure/diet-temperature clues, specialist planning and perioperative warming supplement the existing 14 complete anaphylaxis sections; no contradictory diagnostic assumption.
exclusions_considered: Cold urticaria without respiratory/circulatory compromise is not counted as this leaf.
Hypothermia/cold injury and food-ingredient allergy are different categories.

category_decisions.rationale: Known systemic mastocytosis context now has trigger/skin-negative danger and perioperative/VIT guidance. The full category also needs appropriate diagnosed non-systemic-mastocytosis activation disorders and paediatric care linkage, not a synonym expansion.
exclusions_considered: Idiopathic anaphylaxis without established mast-cell disorder remains separate.
Mastocytosis and MCAS diagnoses are not themselves equivalent to each anaphylaxis episode.
remaining: Relapse/follow-up management for established relevant mast-cell activation disorders beyond systemic mastocytosis.

dispute_adjudication.resolution: Retain existing regional differences in rescue devices, observation and referral. Added US conditional indefinite-VIT guidance and German/Austrian prolonged/permanent option are stated separately. Cold exposure and perioperative advice is population-specific, with no universal dose or prophylaxis prescription.
